title: JellyFishy
description: Introduces a brand new mob for the ocean (Jellyfish) just like in real life this mob groups up (10-20 in a group) and basically just moves freely also dont touch em!
body:
#  Jellyfish - Mob Description

Free Roaming Ocean Mob

Will give you stinged effect if you touch it 

Stays in groups up to 20 even higher sometimes

Its about 0.2 mph 

--------------------------------------------------------------
